requirements.description: Scope retry reviews and per-case metadata to selected stable item IDs.
Present retry descendants as one logical root batch with latest attempts.
Retry or skip current leaf attempts across a logical batch family.
Atomically write a safe full error into the target cell when a case is skipped.
Render failure cells as text and exclude them from human-evaluation task material.
Run full regression, browser QA, fast-forward main, and verify dev.
